shadows.name: resting-paper
shadows.purpose: Optional separation for paper surfaces against the canvas.

shadows.name: lifted-tool
shadows.purpose: Menus, dialogs, and actively lifted controls.

shadows.name: story-artwork
shadows.purpose: Rare separation for artwork that would merge into the canvas.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Color, border, and opacity changes for controls.

motion.name: content-reveal
motion.purpose: New preview media and completed content; replace with static feedback under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action in a working region.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(var(--primary, 200 98% 32%)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground, 204 100% 97%)); font: 600 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: hsl(200 98% 28%); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 200 98% 32%)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary action that preserves hierarchy.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input, 212 26% 83%)); border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(var(--background, 210 40% 98%)); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 222 47% 11%)); font: 600 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: hsl(var(--accent, 210 40% 98%)); border-color: hsl(var(--primary, 200 98% 32%)); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 200 98% 32%)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Working Card
components.description: A flat paper surface for one coherent unit of work.
components.css: .ds-working-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border, 212 26% 83%)); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--card, 210 40% 98%)); color: hsl(var(--card-foreground, 222 47% 11%)); } .ds-working-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 20px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-working-card p { margin: 0; font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-working-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 200 98% 32%)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A persistent-label working field with a clear focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground, 222 47% 11%)); font: 600 14px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input, 212 26% 83%)); border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(var(--background, 210 40% 98%)); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 222 47% 11%)); font: 400 16px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 200 98% 32%)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: A labelled destination with a visible current location.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; border-left: 3px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; color: hsl(var(--foreground, 222 47% 11%)); text-decoration: none; font: 600 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: hsl(var(--accent, 210 40% 98%)); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { border-left-color: hsl(var(--primary, 200 98% 32%)); background: hsl(200 98% 32% / 0.08); color: hsl(var(--primary, 200 98% 32%)); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 200 98% 32%)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Story Idea Choice
components.description: One of three complete story concepts with server-owned local artwork.
components.html:
Ada's Orbiting Rescue Bot

A model-rocket rescue turns gravity and continuous free fall into a classroom adventure.
components.css: .ds-story-choice { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border, 212 26% 83%)); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--card, 210 40% 98%)); color: hsl(var(--card-foreground, 222 47% 11%)); } .ds-story-choice img { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; object-fit: cover; border-bottom: 2px solid hsl(var(--foreground, 222 47% 11%)); background: hsl(var(--muted, 215 20% 65%) / 0.18); } .ds-story-choice div { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; } .ds-story-choice h3 { margin: 0; font: 600 22px/1.2 Lora, Georgia, serif; } .ds-story-choice p { margin: 0; font: 400 15px/1.55 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-story-choice button { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(var(--primary, 200 98% 32%)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground, 204 100% 97%)); font: 600 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-story-choice button:hover { background: hsl(200 98% 28%); } .ds-story-choice button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 200 98% 32%)); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
EduComic should feel like a calm workspace where a teacher shapes raw lesson material into a finished visual story. The operational shell stays precise and familiar; story artwork, editorial typography, crisp panel rules, and small production details provide the personality. This is a refinement of the recognizable hackathon interface, not a wholesale rebrand.

Teacher surfaces are primarily Operate experiences: structured, scan-friendly, and restrained. Story choice and reading surfaces let the artifact lead. Student surfaces are warmer and more immersive, but they remain part of the same system rather than a second theme.
keyCharacteristics: Calm operational structure with authored editorial moments.
Real comic imagery as the primary visual authority.
Blue paper-and-ink palette with yellow used as a rare story spark.
Crisp borders and moderate corners instead of pills and floating cards everywhere.
Honest, progressive provider states that remain useful with reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Spark Rule
rules.body: Yellow should identify one meaningful story moment per region; its rarity gives it value.

rules.name: The Artifact Leads Rule
rules.body: When comic art is present, surrounding color recedes rather than competing with it.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Narrative moments use Lora; operating the product uses Inter. Do not apply the display face to dense settings, tables, or form controls.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Lifted Rule
rules.body: Elevation communicates state or physical layering; it is not default decoration.

dos: Do reuse the existing route structure, controls, palette family, and accessibility improvements.
Do use real local comic imagery to explain the product before adding decoration.
Do show complete idea summaries and use the selected summary as canonical story description.
Do keep teacher prompts available as clearly labelled lesson provenance.
Do provide meaningful status, static reduced-motion feedback, and text alternatives for image-based stories.
Do make simulated public-demo behavior unmistakable.
donts: Don't restore caller-controlled URL fetching or persist expiring provider delivery URLs.
Don't clamp the text a teacher needs to compare story ideas.
Don't use the lesson prompt as fallback marketing copy for a story.
Don't reintroduce generic gradients, hover-scale cards, unlabeled floating actions, or a second product name.
Don't create a parallel visual system for the fictional demo.
Don't trade truthful state, accessibility, or data-loss protection for visual polish.
